meta.title: Samadhan — Civic problems, solved together
meta.description: Report public civic problems with your neighbours or find verified local helpers nearby. A bilingual, mobile-first civic utility.

hero.eyebrow: Bilingual Civic Action + Local Service Marketplace
hero.subtitle: Choose Global Mode for civic campaigns and community pool funding across all Indian states, or Local Mode to book verified nearby service providers.

preview.issueFooter: Every ₹1 moves this closer to action.

hero.title: Solve public issues together. Book trusted local services.

how.title: Three simple steps. Real collective pressure.
how.subtitle: Global mode turns small contributions into visible, escalating civic campaigns.
how.step1Text: Add a photo, drop a map pin and pay a simulated ₹5 report fee. Your issue joins the public feed.
how.step2Text: People facing the same problem support it for ₹1 each. Every contribution grows the issue fund.
how.step3Text: At ₹200 the issue earns a Spotlight campaign. At ₹500 it escalates with a formal email to the authority.

modes.title: Pick the mode that fits the need.
modes.subtitle: Public problems need collective pressure. Personal needs need a trusted pair of hands.

global.label: Global Mode
global.title: Fix what affects everyone.
global.description: Report broken roads, garbage dumps, water outages and dead streetlights. Neighbours chip in, and the fund unlocks social and formal escalation.

local.label: Local Mode
local.title: Find help you can verify.
local.description: Discover admin-verified plumbers, electricians, cab drivers, cleaners, carpenters and locksmiths near you — then connect safely.

trust.title: Built for trust from day one.
trust.subtitle: A civic platform only works when people feel safe using it. These rules are part of the architecture, not an afterthought.
trust.item1Text: Every fee and fund is simulated in integer paise. No real payments are handled.
trust.item2Text: Medical services are intentionally excluded from the local marketplace.
trust.item3Text: Public posts use facts, photos and official handles — never personal attacks.
trust.disclaimerText: Samadhan records and amplifies public issues transparently. It never claims government authority or commands officials.
trust.disclaimer: Samadhan is an academic prototype using simulated paise — not an official government portal.

why.title: Why ₹5 / ₹1?
why.body: Small simulated fees deter spam reports and show real community commitment. If an issue is rejected as invalid, every rupee is refunded.
why.official: Pooled support unlocks official Spotlight social campaigns at ₹200 and formal departmental escalation at ₹500 (₹20 / ₹50 in demo mode).
why.note: 100% simulated paise only — no real money is collected or transferred.

walkthrough.title: How Samadhan works
walkthrough.subtitle: Switch between the two modes below to preview each workflow.

global.step1Text: Select Social Explosion or Pool Funds, assign Small/Medium/Large priority, and pick India → State/UT → City.
global.step2Text: Citizens add support or contribute funds atomically from their simulated wallet toward the dynamic threshold.
global.step3Text: Threshold triggers public social campaigns or funded execution, and records who resolved the issue.

local.step1Text: Filter verified providers across 7 everyday categories by state, city, rating, price, or GPS distance.
local.step2Text: Choose a date and time slot right from a provider card or profile with clear upfront pricing.
local.step3Text: Providers accept, complete work, and receive payouts minus platform commission while consumers rate the experience.

pool.guideSubtitle: This is a community pool for this one issue — not a donation to Samadhan.
pool.guideStep1Text: The reporter's report fee seeds this pool. Neighbours can add ₹10–₹250 anytime while the issue is open.
pool.guideStep2Text: No one can withdraw early. At {{goal}}, the named responsible organisation starts the work.
pool.guideStep3Text: Every expense is posted with item, amount and a note. If an admin rejects the issue, all contributions are returned.
pool.guideRefund: Rejected as invalid? Every contributor gets an automatic wallet refund — no request needed.
pool.guideSimulated: Simulated paise only — this college prototype never moves real money.

pool.guideStatusSpending: Contributions are still open, and logged expenses appear below with receipts.
pool.guideStatusGoal: Goal reached — funded work can now be executed.
pool.guideStatusRefunded: Issue rejected — contributions were automatically refunded.
